remaining_nonblocking_limitations: P02 canonical A4 refit evidence is limited to one executed refit repeat and governed deep anchor budgets; five-repeat stability and dense deep-budget characterization are not established.
P02 low-label evidence uses one frozen subset per budget rather than repeated independent subset sampling.
BNCI2014_001 contributes one held-out P02 test participant and does not support participant-level inferential generalization.
Stage 18S is post-hoc descriptive sensitivity evidence and does not modify canonical Stage 18/G18.

The cumulative evidence remains public-benchmark/non-clinical and does not establish clinical effectiveness, deployment safety, calibrated uncertainty, abstention policy, temporal/stress robustness, or embodiment effectiveness.
External literature headline results are generally contextual/methodological references because protocols, supervision, splits, populations, and metrics differ.
